title: Premium Billing Accounts Discount Rate Card: AutoPay and Annual Prepay
content:
Two discounts exist on Premium Billing Accounts arrangements, and this rate card states each one per arrangement.

- **AutoPay discount** — USD per billed month credited off the invoice for automatic draft.
- **Prepay discount** — integer percent off the twelve monthly premiums when billed annually in advance.
- **Prepay unearned basis** — unearned premium on an annual prepay: unearned months at discounted rate means the remaining full months times the discounted monthly rate; not applicable elsewhere.

| Arrangement | AutoPay discount per billed month (USD) | Prepay discount (percent) | Prepay unearned basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 0.00 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 1.00 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 0.00 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 0.00 | 4 | unearned months at discounted rate |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 0.00 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 0.00 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 0.00 | 0 | not applicable |

**Reading the card.** Only Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly carries an AutoPay discount (1.00 per billed month), and only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay carries a prepay discount (4 percent) and an unearned-premium basis at the discounted rate. Every other arrangement shows 0.00, 0 percent and not applicable.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On an Annual Prepay account whose twelve monthly premiums total 600.00, a 4 percent prepay discount removes 24.00, leaving 576.00 billed; the discounted monthly rate is 576.00 divided by twelve, 48.00. Under the unearned-months basis, three remaining full months would be 144.00.
